title: Add list_flow_runs to the platform tool-name registry (service-ai-studio)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSzhXR4yUAgwq1bQRi

Priority p2. Split from #34368 by the ui seat: this is that card's `packages/spec` half, moved to the spec lane because `dispatch-gates --tier` flags `packages/spec/src/**` as a contract surface.

## What happens

The cloud package `service-ai-studio` registers a build-agent tool, `list_flow_runs`. It reads a flow's recent runs as the caller, so the in-app agent can answer "did my automation work?". `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']` in `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts` does not list it.

That registry is what `packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts` checks an authored tool reference against (`PLATFORM_PROVIDED_TOOL_NAMES`). Adding the name WIDENS what that check accepts. So the seat reads this as `Clause-②: yes`, and it owes the contract review.

## Expected

1. Add `'list_flow_runs'` to `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']` in alphabetical order (after `'get_record_history'`, before `'list_metadata'`). Keep `platform-tool-names.test.ts` green and update its expectations if it enumerates the list.
2. **The ui half lands first** on #34368. It puts the name in `AHEAD_OF_PIN` in `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/toolLabels-locale-parity-7481.test.ts`, with labels in every locale pack. That file's last case fails while a name is in both the registry and `AHEAD_OF_PIN`. So this PR also moves `list_flow_runs` from `AHEAD_OF_PIN` to `GRADUATED` in that test, per the file's own note.
3. Add a changeset for `@objectstack/spec` (patch) in root `.changeset/`.
4. The cloud side deletes its AHEAD entry for this name on the pin bump that carries this.

Blocked-by #34368 (the ui half, for item 2 only; item 1 alone does not depend on it).
